assessments: peer-reviewed Pattern Recognition LEViT reports five-run task-free results, a direct DKF ablation, cross-domain accuracy/component counts and threshold sensitivity; expansion is label/task-boundary agnostic but capacity grows materially, threshold calibration is dataset-specific, and no independent rerun is established

peer-reviewed Neurocomputing EG-CNN gives exact single-pass Class/Domain-IL results without task boundaries or image replay, including class-emergence benefits; strongest same-label Domain-IL shift is mild, there is no calibrated detection-delay/false-alarm experiment, and public reproducibility/independent replication remain weak

peer-reviewed EJOR budget-adaptive allocation has exact finite-budget PCS tables against classical OCBA and a theoretically motivated gap/variance rule; gains vary by example from small to double-digit percentage points, with no evidence they transfer unchanged outside ranking-and-selection assumptions and no independent replication identified

peer-reviewed real laboratory adsorption study demonstrates sequential model discrimination and model-set revision, including discrimination after five added experiments; accessible primary evidence lacks a matched random/nonadaptive experiment-count baseline, so no speedup factor or general sample-efficiency gain is earned

multiple peer-reviewed clustered group-sequential studies analytically model dependence and report simulation operating characteristics near nominal alpha/power, including 5,000-replication designs; transfer to nested step→trajectory→task agent evaluation is untested and cluster choice/few-cluster validity remain open

primary clustered-survival and longitudinal GEE work directly shows when independent increments fail and motivates full-covariance information-time construction; strong methodological evidence, but no agent-specific diagnostic or few-cluster validation is yet demonstrated

foundational time-uniform supermartingale theory supports anytime-valid inference under explicit filtration/conditional-mgf conditions rather than arbitrary correlation; structurally strong but not an agent-benchmark result and provides no direct matched ablation for adaptive judge/task dependence

primary repeated-record and clustered-design studies quantify anti-conservative variance from treating correlated records as independent; a structural zero-covariance horizon ablation removes the discrepancy, strengthening causal interpretation, while agent task/trajectory hierarchy and sequential stopping transfer remain untested

controlled 3-model×3-harness fixed SWE-bench subset reports 8.5–13.0pp harness ranges, 7.80× variance ratio and 6/9 ranking reversals with public code/configs; retrieved version is a preprint/position paper and committed raw final-result CSVs are absent, so independent recomputation is incomplete

primary 2026 study uses three runs across multiple WebArena domains/models and shows budget-aware vanilla actors often match or beat AWM/ASI/ReasoningBank while using comparable or fewer total tokens; the control is practical/approximate rather than exact per-task token matching, so the result rejects same-step baseline sufficiency, not memory/skills generally

same primary study quantifies failure-derived workflow/memory admission and false-success labels against ground-truth evaluators, providing direct mechanism-risk evidence; the diagnosis that missing intermediate evidence is the cause is observational rather than a randomized judge-input intervention and is not independent replication

primary long-horizon benchmark includes a controlled reset intervention stratified by persistent-state quality and finds reset helps corrupted/medium trajectories while harming healthy ones; exact group effect sizes are not extracted here, code/independent replication are not established, and the result supports conditional reset rather than an optimal rollback policy

primary ICML-2026 Spotlight benchmark varies injected error depth across 1,216 recovery cases and reports a large 800k-data recovery training program with headline OSWorld outcomes; exact depth-wise/component values remain primary-table unverified in this wave, limiting causal decomposition

primary systems paper reports approximately 14ms checkpoint and 5ms rollback and more search capacity under fixed time; this is strong infrastructure evidence but contains no behavioral checkpoint-cadence ablation, so it cannot support 'checkpoint more often improves success'

controlled preference-noise study sweeps 5–50% across multiple noise types, seeds and two alignment tasks and shows nonlinear degradation near chance plus mitigation boundaries; it is alignment rather than evolutionary search, so the ~40–50% danger region is only a quantitative prior, not a universal population-search threshold

Duel-Evolve directly uses Bayesian pairwise self-preferences, uncertainty-aware comparison allocation and order-consistency filtering in evolutionary LLM search with strong benchmark gains and a Best-of-N control; it does not inject known judge-error rates and lacks independent replication, so systematic-bias tolerance remains unmeasured

ICLR-2026 RE-PO directly injects annotator noise, estimates reliability and reports downstream alignment gains, providing strong controlled evidence for reliability inference; transfer from preference alignment to evolutionary archive decisions is indirect and not itself a search-stability result

peer-reviewed ACL-2026 AgentRevive reports direct component ablations on two backbones, with learned state-policy removal causing the largest average drops and reversible Active/Standby/Terminated operation; evaluation uses at most five agents and lacks a pure standby-vs-hard-delete isolation, limiting the exact revival attribution

peer-reviewed Physical Review Research study includes a same-node/same-parameter golden-vs-linear frequency-spacing control, repeated MNIST and synthetic spike experiments, significance tests and author notebooks; no independent rerun was found and biological golden-ratio interpretation remains unproved

ICLR-2024 Wave-RNN reports long-sequence, psMNIST and noisy sequential CIFAR-10 results, three-seed appendices, component ablations and official code; advantage is scope-specific, losing on plain sMNIST and to stronger recurrent baselines on noisy CIFAR, with no independent replication established

independent public ReasoningBank implementation provides matched one-shot/naive-retry/fresh-bank/persistent-bank SWE-bench Lite comparisons across seeds and task-native scoring; persistent memory is wrong-sign in this bounded setup, but half of intended persistent cells are lost to infrastructure, the task pool is bimodal, raw per-cell data are absent, and this is not an exact replication of the original method

Lean proof-state snapshotting reports 5.6–50× wall-clock speedups with reconstruction/elaboration dominating fallback branch time, materially changing branching economics; evidence is a small preprint slice on one machine and the advertised implementation was not yet independently auditable

Pythagoras diffusion prover provides a controlled negative comparison: diffusion reaches 63.25% MiniF2F pass@32 versus 74.6% for a restricted autoregressive 4B comparison, with public model/code artifacts; this bounds current iterative diffusion refinement but is not compiler-guided repair evidence

primary Coq study reranks tactics with mined transition history and reports +5.17% to +12.14% proved theorems across four base provers; evidence supports history-sensitive search priors but transfer to Lean and incremental value beyond semantic/compiler features remain untested

AutoResearchClaw verification-gate ablation on ten topics shows removing measurement-bound verification inflates apparent acceptance while 3/5 accepted outputs contain unsupported/fabricated measured values; small best-of-3 study is direct causal evidence for provenance gating, while a semantically collapsed zero-valued case shows provenance is not evidence adequacy

Eureka reports very large controlled runtime suites: forced memoization of open search drops success 58.488%→24.492%, while approximate semantic merging yields 100% false merges on 30k adversarial pairs versus 0% for exact/certified equivalence; strong within-report ablations, but suites are largely synthetic/runtime and lack independent scientific-discovery validation

Eureka directly compares governed evolution, no evolution, always-evolve and stall-triggered policies and reports cost/success plus false-promotion and control-cost metrics; evidence strongly supports cost-benefit-gated specialization in its controlled suites, while independent replication and external scientific-validity transfer remain open

HSI uses the same frozen backbone across harness/evolver/meta-evolver and reports direct meta-off/meta-on ablations across five environments plus held-out BabaIsAI and non-monotonic evolution; public code strengthens traceability, but within-family held-out transfer and compound meta edits do not isolate a single meta mechanism and no independent rerun is established

PAST-Bench uses matched persistence-on/off episodes with fresh sessions, 204 episodes, single-mechanism interventions, full-minus-one interactions and multi-model transfer; aggregate Hermes+ improvement is within run-level variation, so evidence is strongest for axis-specific pathway/interference effects rather than a universally better full stack

original RHI claim is paired with an independent bounded reproduction on 8 deterministic tasks×6 seeds: first revision improves, cumulative second revision loses the gain, forced structural growth is harmful and judge order agreement is poor; this is strong independent boundary evidence but not an exact replication of the original 30 open-ended ML-research tasks/backbone

DGM-Hyperagents reports direct compound ablations removing self-improvement or open-ended archive exploration plus a cross-domain transferred-meta-agent result, with official code/logs; parent selection remains handcrafted, internal features are not singly isolated, and no independent replication is established
updates: ARROW public code narrows the causal story: long-term replay is random-priority retention, minibatches come wholly from one sub-buffer, the ratio jointly changes capacity and sampling probability, and replay also seeds imagined policy rollouts; retain strong primary result but do not attribute gain specifically to semantic balancing or world-model-only consolidation, and independent replication remains absent

exact primary EJOR PCS tables now resolve the prior magnitude gap; implement the guardrail as continuous plug-in gap/variance budget-adaptive allocation rather than a hard T threshold, while keeping all gains tied to tested ranking-and-selection examples

recent matched numerical active-vs-passive dual GP-MPC evidence is essentially tied on steady-state error, so downgrade any unconditional active-probing interpretation; retain feasibility evidence and gate exploration by expected information value/cost

transactional full mode and checkpoint replay can be statistically tied on narrow task success while transactional gating reports 0/500 invalid irreversible sends and stronger concurrency/effect-safety outcomes; preserve the distinction between state recovery and external-effect safety rather than treating checkpointing as a substitute for transactional commit semantics

prior lead is resolved by the ACL-2026 primary paper and direct component ablations; current worker labels the same mechanism C23. Downstream canonicalization should merge the alias while preserving that no pure standby-vs-hard-delete toggle or >5-agent scaling evidence exists

Argus code mechanically couples reviewer outcomes to durable backlog/replan/promotion paths and exposes reviewer/self-review statistics, but independent review is policy/vertical-dependent, routing is nonrandom and stage-certificate persistence can be fail-soft; treat operational counts as descriptive rather than reviewer causal lift
